_about: Top 10 bestsellers shown on the 📈 bestsellers page. Each list: name/en/flag/c (colour)/asof, books in rank order. A book with ref = an id in books.json reuses that book (cover, reviews, sample pages). Otherwise t/a (English), tz/az (Chinese), en/zh brief. Covers are saved as books/<id>.jpg by books.yml (cover "" = plain drawn cover). nyt + indie are refreshed weekly by tools/build_bestsellers.py.

lists.name: 誠品暢銷榜
lists.asof: 2026 全年 Top 10 · Year so far (17 Nov 2026)

books.en: Silicon Valley investor Naval Ravikant's thoughts on getting rich without getting lucky, and on being happy, gathered from his interviews and tweets. Wealth comes from owning things that earn while you sleep, and from judgment and leverage; happiness is a skill you can practise.
books.zh: 矽谷投資人 Naval Ravikant 嘅訪問同推文整理成書。講點樣唔靠運氣致富：擁有會幫你「瞓覺都賺錢」嘅資產，靠判斷力同槓桿；仲講快樂其實係一種可以練習嘅技能。

books.en: A neuroscientist's practical guide to changing your habits by working with your brain's ability to rewire itself. Short, science-based steps for overthinking, procrastination and negative self-talk.
books.zh: 神經科學家寫嘅實用書：大腦可以自己「重新接線」，所以習慣係改得到嘅。用有科學根據嘅小步驟，對付諗太多、拖延同埋負面嘅自我對話。

books.en: A Japanese writer living in Finland describes how Nordic people treat time: short working days, long holidays, saunas and saying no without guilt. A gentle book about slowing down.
books.zh: 住喺芬蘭嘅日本作家，觀察北歐人點對待時間：準時收工、放長假、焗桑拿、理直氣壯咁講「唔」。一本教人慢落嚟嘅療癒書。

books.en: Toad from The Wind in the Willows is depressed, and his friends send him to a counsellor, Heron. Over ten sessions he learns why he feels the way he does. A friendly way into how therapy works.
books.zh: 《柳林風聲》入面嘅蛤蟆先生抑鬱咗，朋友叫佢去見心理師蒼鷺。十次面談之中，佢慢慢明白自己點解會咁。用童話帶你了解心理輔導係點運作。

books.en: How tiny changes add up: get 1% better every day. Clear's four laws make a good habit obvious, attractive, easy and satisfying, and a bad one the opposite. Focus on systems and on who you want to become, not on goals.
books.zh: 細小改變點樣累積成大成果：每日進步 1%。作者提出四個法則：令好習慣變得明顯、吸引、容易、有滿足感，壞習慣就反過嚟。重點唔係目標，而係系統同埋你想成為點樣嘅人。

books.en: Two words, "let them": stop trying to control what other people think, say and do, and put that energy into what you can control. Robbins pairs it with "let me" to take charge of your own life.
books.zh: 兩個字：「隨佢」。唔好再嘗試控制人哋點諗、點講、點做，將精力放返喺自己控制得到嘅嘢。再配合「讓我」，主動掌握自己嘅人生。

books.en: A plain-language reading of the Diamond Sutra, treating it less as religion and more as a guide to seeing through attachment and worry in everyday life.
books.zh: 用淺白嘅說話講解《金剛經》，唔係當宗教書，而係當做一本教你放低執著、減少煩惱嘅生活指南。

books.en: A short fable: a lost traveller stops at a café in the middle of nowhere, where the menu asks three questions, starting with "Why are you here?". A quick, gentle read about finding your purpose.
books.zh: 一個短篇寓言：迷路嘅旅人喺荒郊見到一間咖啡館，餐牌上有三條問題，第一條係「你點解喺度？」。輕鬆易讀，講搵返人生目標。

books.tz: 人生只有兩件事，關你屁事和關我屁事
books.a: Lao Yang de Mao Tou Ying
books.en: About 42 short essays on boundaries: what other people do is their business, what you do is yours. A light, blunt book about not over-managing others or letting them manage you.
books.zh: 大約 42 篇短文講界線：人哋做乜係人哋嘅事，你做乜係你嘅事。輕鬆直接，教你唔好管太多，亦唔好俾人管住。

books.en: The sixth book in the Court of Thorns and Roses series. Former alliances must be restored to fight the threat of Koschei the Deathless.
books.zh: 奇幻系列《荊棘與玫瑰之庭》第六集。舊盟友要重新聯手，對抗不死者 Koschei 嘅威脅。

books.en: Thirteen short stories, set in the Empyrean world, in which cadets compete to earn the bond of a dragon.
books.zh: 《第四翼》世界嘅十三個短篇故事：軍校生互相競爭，爭取同巨龍結盟。

books.en: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.
books.zh: 《姊妹》（The Help）作者等咗十幾年嘅第二本小說。大蕭條時期，日子越嚟越難，幾個女人各自諗辦法改善生活。

books.en: When a couple is kidnapped during a honeymoon trip in the French countryside, a young lawyer is used as part of a C.I.A. operation.
books.zh: 一對新婚夫婦喺法國鄉郊度蜜月時被綁架，一個年輕律師被捲入中情局嘅營救行動。

books.en: The 21st book in the Harry Bosch series. Bosch investigates the facility where he was a ward of the state in his youth.
books.zh: Harry Bosch 系列第 21 集。Bosch 調查佢細個寄住過嘅兒童院。

books.en: Circumstances force Julia Barlow to retreat to her family’s estate, which contains the dark energy of a 1692 witchcraft execution.
books.zh: Julia Barlow 退隱到家族大宅，呢度同 1692 年一宗處決女巫事件有關，而過去似乎仲未放過佢。《女傭》作者嘅懸疑驚慄小說。

books.en: A collection of three holiday novellas: Sweater Weather , Stealing Christmas and Marry Little Christmas .
books.zh: 三個溫馨嘅聖誕愛情中篇故事，合成一本精裝版。

books.en: A woman whose magic hurt civilization 20 years ago has her loyalty tested and questions which course of action to take.
books.zh: 奇幻二部曲第一集：一個女人嘅忠誠受到考驗。

books.en: In 16th-century Ireland, Grace O’Malley endures betrayal and hardship before leading a fleet of ships to defend her land.
books.zh: 歷史小說，寫十六世紀愛爾蘭真實人物 Grace O'Malley：一位敢同英國王室對抗嘅女族長兼船長。

books.en: A pawnshop owner gives a financially strapped wife a potentially risky offer; inspired by O. Henry's The Gift of the Magi .
books.zh: 一個帶黑色轉折嘅短篇故事，靈感來自歐亨利嘅聖誕經典《聖誕禮物》。

books.en: Romance, danger, and intrigue await you in the breathtaking sixth book in the #1 bestselling Court of Thorns and Roses (ACOTAR) series.
books.zh: 奇幻系列《荊棘與玫瑰之庭》第六集。舊盟友要重新聯手，對抗不死者 Koschei 嘅威脅。

books.en: A sweeping historical adventure inspired by the life of Grace O’Malley, the legendary Irish folk heroine who risked everything to defend her people. A September 2026 Indie Next Pick.
books.zh: 歷史小說，寫十六世紀愛爾蘭真實人物 Grace O'Malley：一位敢同英國王室對抗嘅女族長兼船長。

books.en: A bold, big-hearted novel about a group of unbreakable women, fighting for what's rightfully theirs — and the power of friendship to change everything. A May 2026 Indie Next Pick.
books.zh: 《姊妹》（The Help）作者等咗十幾年嘅第二本小說。大蕭條時期，日子越嚟越難，幾個女人各自諗辦法改善生活。

books.en: A story of a brief, passionate, life-changing love affair, wrapped up in what might be the greatest romance of all: our eternal human longing for art and beauty. An October 2026 Indie Next Pick.
books.zh: 憑《惡魔銅頭蛇》奪普立茲獎嘅 Barbara Kingsolver 最新小說。

books.en: It’s 1982, New York City. Crime is on the rise, muggings are in the streets, and Batter Gray, recent college graduate with a skill that no one wants — an “ear” for poetry — is worried about his future. An October 2026 Indie Next Pick.
books.zh: 《化學課》作者 Bonnie Garmus 嘅第二本小說。

books.en: The National Book Award finalist and bestselling author returns with a breathtaking contemporary epic: a masterpiece by turns sweeping and intimate, that reckons with ambition and moderation, lust and loyalty, personal dreams and familial duty. An October 2026 Indie Next Pick.

Bring on the holiday cheer in this delightful collection of three feel-good novellas from the bestselling author of The Night We Met — with bonus recipes and full-page illustrations, perfect for gifting!
Phillip has fished out of the water an object he can't keep. A creature that keeps changing. An artifact he must take inland, before it destroys everything he thinks he knows.

The acclaimed, prize-winning #1 New York Times bestselling writer returns with a moving, luminous novel that reminds us of the sweetness and impermanence of life and the power of connection to defy time. The #1 Indie Next Pick for June 2026.

books.t: Miss Wolcott's Ghost (Chief Inspector Gamache Novel #21)
books.en: The next new mystery in Louise Penny’s bestselling Three Pines mystery series featuring Chief Inspector Armand Gamache.
